name: Lud
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs

points: “The children of Shem; Elam”: Elam are your modern-day East Indians, and the people in Iran. “And Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram.”

note.label: | SABBATH EVENING CLASS: The Third Kingdom of Babylon

points: The sons of Shem are named: Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram, and the sons that came after them.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 1: The Generations from Adam to Edom

points: Pul is Libya, and Lud is Lydia; Tubal is Turkey; and Javan is Greece; and to the isles afar off.

He will set a sign among them and send those that escape to the nations, to Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, to Tubal and Javan, and to the isles afar off that have not heard his fame nor seen his glory, and they shall declare his glory among the Gentiles.

note.label: Isaiah 66: The Most High's Throne, Zion's Travail, and Judgment by Fire

points: The inhabitants of Zidon and Arvad were her mariners, her wise men were her pilots, and the men of Persia, Lud, and Phut were in her army, hanging their shields and helmets in her to set forth her comeliness.
Ethiopia, Libya, Lydia, all the mingled people, and the men of the land that is in league shall fall with them by the sword; those that uphold Egypt shall fall and the pride of her power come down.

“Ethiopia, and Libya, and Lydia, and all the mingled people, and Chub”. Y’all see Libya right next to Egypt: Libya going to get it, Egypt going to get it. Lydia, that’s Turkey. Chub is Chad; write that down: Chub is Chad, Chad is Chub. “And the men of the land that is in league, shall fall with them by the sword”: they all going to get it.
